query:
SELECT id, nameAr, nameEn, parentId
FROM product_categories
WHERE (nameAr, nameEn) IN (
  SELECT nameAr, nameEn
  FROM product_categories
  WHERE parentId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nameAr, nameEn
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY nameAr, id;
